verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs confirm MFA support including one-time passwords (TOTP-style OTP) and recovery/backup codes as factors (auth0-docs-38), and general MFA framing (auth0-docs-23). However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents step-up authentication enforcement (e.g., contextual/adaptive step-up policies) as part of the MFA feature set. Missing for 10: explicit step-up authentication/enforcement documentation, TOTP authenticator app specifics beyond generic 'one-time passwords', and independent verification of these MFA configurations working in practice.
